---
title: "Data Sources"
---

Each country profile draws on the sources below. Because profiles are
submitted by individual country teams, not every profile cites every
source — check a profile's own **References** section (section 11) for
what was actually used there.

- **DHS StatCompiler / DHS surveys** — household survey indicators such
  as prevalence, mortality, and intervention coverage.
- **MICS** — Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys, used alongside DHS for
  survey-derived indicators where available.
- **DHIS2** — routine health information system data behind the
  incidence and health-system indicators.
- **Malaria Atlas Project (MAP)** — modeled surfaces and administrative
  boundary layers used in stratification and admin-boundary maps.
- **Natural Earth** — the boundary data behind this site's own Africa
  map on the homepage.

Questions about a specific number or map in a profile belong with that
country's own team — see the profile's References section for citations
and contacts.
